title: From an intrinsic presentation witness to canonical actual completeness
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme and $d$ a Noetherian adic coefficient datum over $A$ with finitely generated ideal $I$ and finite perfect quotients [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Work on the chosen small pro-etale presentation, with coefficient universe one above the scheme universe and actual completed coefficient ring $A_X$. Let $E$ be the specified exact scalar-preserving equivalence from actual $A_X$-module sheaves to module sheaves over the constant completed ring in the small-site presentation [lem-weil-pbc-completed-constant-coefficient-equivalence], and let $F$ be its derived equivalence. Let $M\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_X))$. Suppose there exist a finite tuple $b$ generating $I$, a complex $C$ of presentation modules and an isomorphism $j:Q(C)\xrightarrow{\sim}F(M)$ such that the explicit completed-coefficient Koszul fiber unit on $C$ for $b$ is invertible after localization. This is the intrinsic-completeness witness used in the integral constructible category [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete].

Then for every finite tuple $a$ generating $I$, every actual completed-coefficient cochain representative $D$ and every isomorphism $i:Q(D)\xrightarrow{\sim}M$, the specified actual intrinsic unit $\eta_{a,D,i}:M\to M^{\wedge}_{a,D}$ of [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion] is an isomorphism. In particular this holds for the stipulated generator tuple and the canonical representative used by the Koszul reflector [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-completion-reflector]. It also implies invertibility of the canonical strict quotient-tower completion unit of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Consequently the underlying object of every integral bounded constructible complete object satisfies that canonical actual completeness predicate. No additional hypothesis on $X$, the representatives or the generating tuple is imposed.
